author: ThomasOliveira
quote: This is my first time playing Ocarina of Time, having already completed BotW, TotK, and Twilight Princess. Honestly, choosing this remake over the original was the best decision I could have made. The game is perfect and incredibly fun. It never gets tiresome, and I’m currently on the verge of achieving 100% completion. It’s absolutely worth it—it’s already become one of my favorite games.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
